system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or higher. During this Main Process, you gain a +[SRx5] bonus to [Magic Attack] damage rolls.

(CR21): Increase bonus to +[SRx7].

A feat that increases the power of the spell cast immediately after using a spell that increases magical power. By putting the intention of a deadly death into words, the demonic blow gains unparalleled destructive power.
